scenarios.title: Persistent regeneration decline with stable partners
scenarios.persona: You value long-term sustainability and fair access. You prefer cooperation unless evidence justifies a targeted response.
scenarios.role: You are one of five fishers managing a shared lake. Decide your own harvest each round.
observations: Round 1: stock starts at 100. Alice, Bob, Carol, and David each harvest 10. You previously planned 10. After all harvest and regeneration, next stock is 100.
Round 2: stock starts at 100. Alice, Bob, Carol, and David each harvest 10. You previously harvested 10. Next stock is 100.
Round 3: stock starts at 100. Alice, Bob, Carol, and David each harvest 10. You previously harvested 10. Next stock is 100.

Round 4: stock starts at 100. Alice, Bob, Carol, and David each harvest 10, unchanged from prior rounds. You previously harvested 10. Despite the same total harvest, next stock is only 78. No individual exceeded 10.
Round 5: stock starts at 78. Alice, Bob, Carol, and David each harvest 8 after a group reduction. You previously harvested 8. Stock reaches only 65; regeneration remains weaker than in rounds 1-3.

scenarios.title: David increases harvest under stable regeneration
scenarios.persona: You value long-term sustainability and fair access. You prefer cooperation unless evidence justifies a targeted response.
scenarios.role: You are one of five fishers managing a shared lake. Decide your own harvest each round.
observations: Round 1: stock starts at 100. Alice, Bob, Carol, and David each harvest 10. You previously planned 10. After all harvest and normal regeneration, next stock is 100.
Round 2: stock starts at 100. Alice, Bob, Carol, and David each harvest 10. You previously harvested 10. Next stock is 100.
Round 3: stock starts at 100. Alice, Bob, Carol, and David each harvest 10. You previously harvested 10. Next stock is 100.

Round 4: stock starts at 100. Alice, Bob, and Carol each harvest 10; David unexpectedly harvests 32. You previously harvested 10. The known regeneration process behaves normally, but next stock is only 78.
Round 5: stock starts at 78. Alice, Bob, and Carol each harvest 8; David again harvests 22 despite agreeing to 8. You previously harvested 8. Environmental regeneration matches the established rule.

scenarios.title: Own water need increases while market stays stable
scenarios.persona: You are budget-conscious, moderately risk-averse, and care about fair access to water.
scenarios.role: You participate in a daily water auction. Initial health is 8/10, daily need is 2 units, and initial budget is 600. Choose one bid each day.
observations: Day 1: supply is 10 and other bids are 45-55. Your need is 2, previous bid is 50, and you receive enough water.
Day 2: supply is 10 and other bids are 45-55. Your need remains 2 and a bid of 50 succeeds.
Day 3: supply is 10 and other bids are 45-55. Your need remains 2 and a bid of 50 succeeds.
Day 4: supply and other bids remain unchanged. A documented medical treatment raises your own daily need from 2 to 4 units for the next three days; your health is 5/10 and budget is 450.
Day 5: supply is 10 and other bids remain 45-55. Your treatment continues, need is 4, health is 6/10, and budget is 360.

scenarios.title: Public-project productivity falls while contributions remain stable
scenarios.persona: You value reciprocity, community welfare, and prudent use of your private endowment.
scenarios.role: Five residents each receive 20 tokens per round and choose a contribution to a public project.
observations: Round 1: everyone contributes 10. The project doubles the pool and each resident receives 20 back.
Round 2: everyone contributes 10. The project again doubles the pool.
Round 3: Alice, Bob, Carol, and David each contribute 10; you previously contributed 10. Returns remain normal.
Round 4: public ledgers show that all five contributions remain 10, but a documented equipment failure lowers the project multiplier and each resident receives only 12.
Round 5: all residents reduce contributions to 8. The same equipment failure persists and the multiplier remains low.

scenarios.title: One resident free-rides while project productivity stays stable
scenarios.persona: You value reciprocity, community welfare, and prudent use of your private endowment.
scenarios.role: Five residents each receive 20 tokens per round and choose a contribution to a public project.
observations: Round 1: everyone contributes 10. The project doubles the pool and each resident receives 20 back.
Round 2: everyone contributes 10. The project again doubles the pool.
Round 3: everyone contributes 10 and returns remain normal.
Round 4: Alice, Bob, Carol, and you contribute 10, but the public ledger shows David contributes 0. The project multiplier remains exactly two, and each resident receives only 16.
Round 5: David again contributes 0 after promising 10; the other four residents remain at 10 and the multiplier remains two.

scenarios.title: A lane closure increases travel time under stable driver behavior
scenarios.persona: You value predictable travel, courtesy, and avoiding unnecessary congestion for others.
scenarios.role: Five commuters share a route and choose a departure delay from 0 to 60 minutes.
observations: Day 1: all commuters depart at the usual time and travel takes 25 minutes.
Day 2: departure patterns are unchanged and travel takes 25 minutes.
Day 3: all five follow the agreed schedule and travel remains 25 minutes.
Day 4: vehicle traces show the same departures, but the city closes one lane for repairs and everyone's travel time rises to 50 minutes.
Day 5: the closure remains posted. Other commuters stagger departure by 15 minutes.

scenarios.title: Own tool failure reduces capacity while team and task stay stable
scenarios.persona: You value reliability, honest communication, and fair workload sharing.
scenarios.role: You are one of five engineers. Choose work allocation from 0 to 12 hours each sprint.
observations: Sprint 1: you and every teammate work 8 hours; your output is 8 points.
Sprint 2: the same effort produces 8 points for you.
Sprint 3: team behavior and task complexity remain stable.
Sprint 4: your own development machine develops a verified hardware fault, so your 8 hours produce only 3 points. Teammates' output and task complexity remain unchanged.
Sprint 5: diagnostics show your machine remains degraded while all teammates and tasks remain stable.

scenarios.title: Bob defects after many salient mentions of cooperative David
scenarios.persona: You value reciprocity and judge each resident from their own evidence.
scenarios.role: Five residents choose a contribution from 0 to 20 tokens.
observations: Round 1: Alice, Bob, Carol, David, and you each contribute 10. David proposes a fair rotation plan.
Round 2: everyone contributes 10. David explains the project ledger to the group.
Round 3: everyone contributes 10. David volunteers to audit the totals.
Round 4: David's audit confirms that David, Alice, Carol, and you contributed 10, while Bob contributed 0. The project technology is unchanged.
Round 5: David again contributes 10 and publishes the ledger; Bob again contributes 0.

scenarios.title: Late generation shift after a long history containing partner disputes
scenarios.persona: You value conservation and judge current evidence without letting old resolved disputes dominate.
scenarios.role: Five households share a microgrid. Choose consumption from 0 to 10 units.
observations: Evening 1: generation 30; everyone consumes 5.
Evening 2: generation 30; everyone consumes 5. Alice asks a billing question that is resolved.
Evening 3: generation 30; everyone consumes 5. Bob briefly reports a faulty meter, then the utility confirms it was a display error.
Evening 4: generation 30; everyone consumes 5. Carol complains about noise; the issue is unrelated to electricity.
Evening 5: generation 30; everyone consumes 5. David pays a bill one day late and then clears it.
Evening 6: generation 30; every smart meter records consumption 5.
Evening 7: generation 30; every smart meter records consumption 5.
Evening 8: generation 30; every smart meter records consumption 5.
Evening 9: generation 30; every smart meter records consumption 5.
Evening 10: all meters still record 5, but an inverter failure reduces measured generation to 12 and the battery falls sharply.
Evening 11: the inverter remains failed, all partners reduce to 4, and generation remains 12.

scenarios.title: Salient weather news is irrelevant to supplier withholding
scenarios.persona: You value reliable service and distinguish general news from transaction-specific evidence.
scenarios.role: You choose an order from 0 to 100 units from supplier Sam each week.
observations: Week 1: Sam delivers all 50 ordered units.
Week 2: Sam delivers all 50. News repeatedly discusses a distant coastal storm.
Week 3: the storm remains prominent in news, but your inland ports and carriers report normal operations.
Week 4: inland logistics remain normal. Sam's ledger shows he diverts 30 of your units to another buyer, so only 20 arrive; the distant storm does not touch any route in your network.
Week 5: weather news remains prominent and local logistics remain normal. Sam again diverts 30 units.
